page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m4.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s6 server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 vCPUs, which map to 4 physical cores with 1 thread per core. It features a shared CPU allocation model and runs on the KVM hypervisor.

This server type is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage must be attached externally. There are no integrated GPUs. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 1 Gbps, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to its shared CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s6-c1m4.xlarge offers a cost-effective hardware profile for workloads that do not require dedicated CPU resources. The resource density makes it suitable for general-purpose applications, development and testing environments, light web serving, and small database instances where CPU utilization is non-continuous.
